24 (30) | campaign = Factions }} [[Seaguard Gita]] is a [[Luxon]] [[Serpent Clan]] Seaguard and is available as a [[henchman]] in the [[the Jade Sea]] after the [[Convocation]]. She specializes in [[Protection Prayers]]. As a henchman, she is labeled as a "[[Protection Henchman]]." == Locations == {{TOCright}} ;[[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] * [[Kaineng City]] ** {{NPC location|Divine Path}} * [[The Jade Sea]] ** {{NPC location|Aspenwood Gate (Luxon)}} ** {{NPC location|Bai Paasu Reach}} ** {{NPC location|Boreas Seabed|outpost}} (not as a henchman) ** {{NPC location|Breaker Hollow}} ** {{NPC location|Cavalon}} ** {{NPC location|Eredon Terrace}} ** {{NPC location|Gyala Hatchery|outpost}} ** {{NPC location|Jade Flats (Luxon)}} ** {{NPC location|Leviathan Pits}} ** {{NPC location|Seafarer's Rest}} ** {{NPC location|The Aurios Mines|outpost}} ** {{NPC location|Unwaking Waters (Luxon)}} ** {{NPC location|Zos Shivros Channel|outpost}} == Missions == *The Jade Sea ** {{NPC location|Boreas Seabed}} == Skills == ====Henchman==== 12 [[Divine Favor]], 12 [[Protection Prayers]] * {{skill icon|Aegis}} * {{skill icon|Life Sheath}} ([[elite]]) * {{skill icon|Remove Hex}} * {{skill icon|Resurrection Chant}} * {{skill icon|Shielding Hands}} * {{skill icon|Spirit Bond}} ====Foe==== '''Boss in Boreas Seabed mission''' * {{skill icon|Aegis}} * {{skill icon|Draw Conditions}} * {{skill icon|Life Sheath}} ([[elite]]) * {{skill icon|Rebirth}} * {{skill icon|Reversal of Fortune}} * {{skill icon|Spirit Bond}} * {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}} == Evaluation == ; Pros * Can provide both healing and protection. * Can remove [[condition]]s and [[hex]]es. * Party-wide blocking with [[Aegis]]. * Can mitigate large amounts of damage with [[Spirit Bond]]. * [[Resurrection Chant]] usually resurrects allies with more Health than [[Flesh of My Flesh]] or [[Rebirth]]. ; Cons * No [[energy management]] skills. * Less significant active healing than other monk henchmen. * Resurrection Chant has half the range of Flesh of My Flesh or Rebirth. * Only has 6 [[skill]]s equipped. == Dialogue == Boreas Seabed mission outpost: : ''"Any Seaguard would gladly lay down his life for his Champion. It is the strong we follow and none is as strong as the Serpent."'' The Jade Sea town and outposts: : ''"Hello, young one. My name is Gita. As a Seaguard, I've been tasked with training and protecting [[Aurora]] since she was very young. She's a very talented [[Ranger]], and one of our youngest Champions.'' : ''What did you need?"'' We've almost got them!"'' : ''"Stay together!"'' == Items dropped == * [[Bolt of Cloth]] * [[Bolt of Silk]] * [[Jadeite Shard]] == Notes == * She wields a [[Holy Staff]]. * She wears a very slightly modified version of [[Monk Luxon armor]]. == Trivia == * Her henchman skills were updated in the [[Game updates/20091022|22nd October 2009 update]]. ** This added [[Remove Hex]], [[Resurrection Chant]], and [[Shielding Hands]], and removed [[Draw Conditions]], [[Mend Ailment]], [[Reversal of Fortune]], and [[Rebirth]] from her skills. {{Henchmen nav|Factions}} [[Category:Drops cloth]] [[Category:Drops silk]] [[Category:Monk henchmen]]
